learning_outcomes.text: Identify the most important automation technology components (electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic drives, PLC and CNC, fieldbus systems) and assess their functionality.
Structure and design models of simple to medium complexity as state machines in algorithmic and temporal behavior.
Implement and test simple models in the Structured Text programming language.
Understand and apply simple models in MATLAB/Simulink for modeling and simulating simple subsystems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of algorithms in automation technology
teaching_methods: PC-Pool for Matlab/Simulink introduction and exercises
assessment_rules: For 15 or more participants, the assessment is a 60-minute written exam. For fewer than 15 participants, the assessment is a 30-minute oral exam. The exam accounts for 100% of the module grade.
